senses.gloss:
शङ्क् शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. शङ्कते (ep. also P.
-ति), शशङ्के, शङ्किष्यते, अशङ्किष्ट,
शङ्कितुम्, to doubt, be doubtful or uncertain, hesi-
tate; to distrust, fear, dread, be afraid; to suspect,
have a suspicion; to think probable, believe, imagine,
think, opine; (in argumentative works) to ponder
over or propound a doubt or objection: Pass. शङ्क्-
यते, Aor. अशङ्कि, to be doubted, &c.: Caus. शङ्क-
यति, -ते, -यितुम्, Aor. अशशङ्कत्, -त, to cause to
doubt; to frighten; [cf. Lat. cunc-tari; Goth.
hugjan, hugs; Old Germ. hugjan, hugu; Angl.
Sax. hangian, hige, hyge, hogu, hygian, hyggan,
hicgan, hogian.]

शङ्क, अस्, m. a draught-ox; (आ), f. doubt, un-
certainty, hesitation, scruple, distrust, suspicion, mis-
giving, fear, apprehension; an objection started in
disputation; presumption; hope; error; a species
of the Daṇḍaka metre.
—शङ्काकुल (˚का-आक्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, bewildered by doubt, filled with fear or sus-
picion.
—शङ्का-निवर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, putting
an end to doubt.
—शङ्कान्वित (˚का-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, filled with doubt, apprehensive, doubtful, afraid.
—शङ्काभियोग (˚का-अभ्˚), अस्, m. accusation or
charge on suspicion.
—शङ्का-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, full
of doubt or uncertainty, fearful, afraid.
—शङ्का-
शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of a hesitating or diffident dispo-
sition, prone to doubt.
—शङ्कास्पद (˚का-आस्˚),
अम्, n. cause or matter of doubt, subject of appre-
hension, object of suspicion.
—शङ्का-स्पृष्ट, अस्,
आ, अम्, touched with fear, seized with alarm.
—शङ्का-
हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, free from doubt or apprehension.

सङ्क सङ्-क, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Sāy.
[]
fr. rt. कै with सम्; but according to Yāska, Nir.
IX. 14, either fr. rt. सच् or fr. सङ्-कॄ), sounding
together, shouting; having assembled warriors; (in
Naigh. II. 17. सङ्काः is enumerated among the
सङ्ग्राम-नामानि.)

शङ्कन, अस्, m. ‘causing fear or awe,’ N. of a
king.

शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted or ques-
tioned, questionable, doubtful; to be suspected or
apprehended; to be supposed or imagined.

शङ्कमान, अस्, आ, अम्, doubting, suspecting, fear-
ing, apprehending; being doubtful or uncertain.

शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, doubted, apprehended, feared,
suspected, distrusted; doubtful, uncertain; alarmed,
frightened, apprehensive, fearful of (with gen. or
abl.); distrustful, suspicious, suspecting; weak, un-
steady.
—शङ्कित-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one whose
mind is doubtful or suspicious, faint-hearted, timid,
[]
apprehensive.
—शङ्कित-वर्णक, अस्, m. ‘whose
appearance or caste is doubted,’ a thief.

शङ्कितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted, doubtful,
questionable, &c. (= शङ्कनीय).

शङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, doubting, suspecting, fearing,
fearful of; full of danger.

शङ्कुर, अस्, आ, अम्, fearful, formidable, frightful,
terrible.

साङ्कुर साङ्कुर (स-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessing shoots or buds, budding, in bud.

शङ्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted, to be appre-
hended or feared.

शङ्कर शङ्-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (i. e. 2. श
or 2. शम् + 1. कर), causing happiness, conferring
good fortune or prosperity, auspicious, propitious,
well-disposed; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of a
celebrated teacher of the Vedānta philosophy, (see
शङ्कराचार्य below); of a poet; of a com-
mentator on the Bengālī recension of Kālidāsa's
Śakuntalā; of an astronomer, (also called भट्ट-
शङ्कर); of the author of a drama called Śāradā-
tilaka; of the author of the Dvaita-nirṇaya; of
the author of the Karma-vipāka and the Saṃskāra-
bhāskara; of the author of the Rasa-candrikā com-
mentary; of a Dānava; (आ), f. a particular Rāga or
musical mode; (ई), f. the wife of Śiva; Bengal
madder; the Śamī tree.
—शङ्कर-किङ्कर, अस्,
m. ‘Śaṅkara's servant,’ a proper N.
—शङ्कर-
क्रोड, अस्, m., N. of a Nyāya commentary.
—शङ्-
कर-गीता, f., N. of a work.
—शङ्कर-चेतो-विलास,
अस्, m. ‘the play of Śaṅkara's wit,’ N. of an artificial
poem by Śaṅkara-dīkṣita (celebrating the glories of
Vārāṇasī, especially of its kings Yavanāri and Ceta-
siṃha or Cheyt Singh).
—शङ्कर-जी and शङ्कर-
जीक, m., N. of two scribes.
—शङ्कर-तीर्थ, अम्,
n., N. of a chapter of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—शङ्कर-
दिग्-विजय, अस्, m. ‘Śaṅkara's victory over the
world,’ = शङ्कर-विजय below; N. of another
similar work by Mādhava or Abhinava-kālidāsa pro-
fessing to be a short account of Śaṅkarācārya's con-
troversial exploits.
—शङ्कर-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N.
of a writer of the last century (author of the Gaṅ-
gāvatāraṇa-campū-prabandha, Pradyumna-vijaya, and
Śaṅkara-ceto-vilāsa).
—शङ्कर-प्रिय, अस्, m.
‘dear to Śaṅkara,’ the Francoline partridge (= तित्-
तिरि).
—शङ्कर-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the author
of the Kuṇḍoddyotana-darśana.
—शङ्कर-वर्-
धन, अस्, and शङ्कर-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of
two persons.
—शङ्कर-विजय, अस्, m. ‘Śaṅkara's
victory,’ N. of a biography of Śaṅkarācārya by
Ānanda-giri (recording his victories, as a Vedāntin,
over numerous heretics, and refuting the superstitions
prevalent in his day by a popular exposition of the
Vedānta philosophy).
—शङ्कर-संहिता, f., N.
of a part of the Skanda-Purāṇa.
—शङ्कर-सेन,
अस्, m., N. of the author of a commentary on the
Nāḍī-prakāśa.
—शङ्कराचार्य (˚र-आच्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a celebrated teacher of the Vedānta philosophy,
(he is thought to have lived between A. D. 650 and
740, but according to tradition he flourished 200 B. C.,
and was a native of Kerala or Malabar; all accounts
describe him as having led an erratic controversial
life; his learning and sanctity were in such repute
that he was held to have worked various miracles
[amongst others, animating the dead body of a king
Amaru so as to be able to argue with the wife of
Mandana], and to have been an incarnation of the
god Śiva, whose worship he enjoined; he is said to
have died at the age of thirty-two, and, before his
death, to have resided in Cashmere, and afterwards
in the Himālaya; he had four principal disciples,
called Padma-pāda, Hastāmalaka, Sureśvara or Man-
dana, and Troṭaka, and another of his disciples,
Ānanda-giri, wrote a history of his controversial
exploits, called Śaṅkara-vijaya, q. v.; tradition
makes him the founder of one of the prin-
cipal Śaiva sects, the Daś-nāmī-Daṇḍins or ‘Ten-
named Mendicants,’ so called because divided into
ten classes, each distinguished by one or other of the
names of the ten pupils of the above-mentioned
four disciples of Śaṅkara [see शैव]; he is the
reputed author of a large number of original works
[]
with the following titles, Ātma-bodha, Ānanda-laharī,
Ānanda-laharī-stotra, Jñāna-bodhinī, A-parokṣānu-
bhūti-sudhārṇava, Upadeśa-sahasrī, Vākya-sudhā,
Kādi-krama-stuti, Dhanya-stotra, Maṇi-ratna-mālā,
Ganeśa-bhujaṅga-prayāta-stotra, Caturdaśa-mata-
viveka, Tārā-pajjhaṭikā, Tripurī-prakaraṇa; and
commentaries on the following, Chāndogyopani-
shad, Bṛhad-āraṇyakopaniṣad, Praśnopaniṣad, Īśā-
vāsyopaniṣad, Kaṭha-vally-upaniṣad, Taittirīyopa-
niṣad, Aitareyopaniṣad, Kenopaniṣad, Māṇḍūkyo-
paniṣad, Muṇḍakopaniṣad, Brahma-mīmāṃsā or
Śārīraka-mīmāṃsā or Vedānta-sūtra, Bhagavad-gītā,
Mahā-bhārata, Viṣṇu-sahasra-nāman); a N. given
to the president of a Maṭha or college founded by
Śaṅkarācārya.
—शङ्कराचार्य-विजय-दिण्डिम,
N. of a commentary by Dhana-pati on the Saṅkṣepa-
śaṅkara-jaya.
—शङ्करानन्द (˚र-आन्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a commentary on the Muṇḍakopaniṣad.
—शङ्कराभरण (˚र-आभ्˚), अस्, m. a particular
Rāga or musical mode.
—शङ्करावास (˚र-आव्˚),
अस्, m. the abode of Śiva, Kailāsa; a kind of cam-
phor (= कर्पूर-भेद).

शाङ्कर शाङ्कर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शङ्कर), be-
longing to or composed by Śaṅkara; (अस्), m. a
bull; (अम्), n. a form of metre; [cf. शाक्कर,
शार्कर.]
सङ्कर सङ्-कर. See under सङ्-कॄ.

सङ्-कर, अस्, m. mixing together, intermixture,
blending, confusing, confounding, confusion, irregular
mixture, unlawful intermarriage, mixture of caste,
a mixed caste or race (proceeding from the union of
a man with a woman of a higher caste or from the
promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes, and again
from the indiscriminate cohabitation of their descend-
ants amongst each other; cf. योनि-सङ्कर); the
union or mixing together of two figures in the same
passage (in rhetoric); dust, sweepings [cf. अव-कर,
p. 88]; the crackling of flame.
—सङ्कर-ज, अस्,
आ, अम्, born from a mixed marriage.
—सङ्करी-
करण, अम्, n. the act of mixing together, con-
fusing; confusion; causing mixture or loss of caste.
—सङ्करी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to mix together confusedly, cause confusion.
—सङ्करी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, confused, blended or
mixed confusedly; outcast.

सङ्कर; add — contamination, pollution; any
contaminated object.

सङ्-कार, अस्, m. dust, sweepings; the crackling
of flame; (ई), f. a girl recently deflowered, a new
bride.
शङ्कव्य शङ्कव्य. See under शङ्कु below.

शङ्कव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for a stake; (अम्), n.
anything fit for a stake (as wood &c.).

शङ्कु शङ्कु, उस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. I. 37. said to
be fr. rt. शङ्क्; in some senses connected with rt. 1. शक्),
fear, apprehension; a stake, spike, pile, post, pale,
pin, nail, peg, pillar; the spoke of a wheel (Ved.);
a dart, javelin, spear, dagger, weapon (in general);
the trunk of a lopped tree; the style or pin of a
dial (usually twelve fingers long); the measure of
twelve fingers; (in astronomy) the sine of altitude;
a measuring-rod; a long thin column in front of a
pagoda; the penis; the fibres of a leaf; the tree
Shorea Robusta; the skate fish; the perfume called
Nakhī; a goose; an ant-hill; a very high number,
ten billions (as implied by an innumerable collection
of ants, but cf. शङ्ख); a demon; poison, sin;
N. of Śiva; of a Gandharva attendant on Śiva; of
a king; of Kāma; of a son of Ugra-sena; of a poet
(a son of Mayūra).
—शङ्कु-कर्ण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्,
having ears (pointed) like a spear, spike-eared,
pricking the ears; (अस्), m. an ass.
—शङ्कु-जीवा,
f. (in astronomy) the gnomon-sine.
—शङ्कु-तरु,
उस्, or शङ्कु-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the Sāl tree, Shorea
Robusta.
—शङ्कु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, filled with
stakes or spikes; (अती), f., N. of a metre.
—शङ्कु-
शिरस्, आस्, m. ‘spear-headed,’ N. of a Dānava.
सङ्कु सङ्कु, उस्, m. (doubtful), a hole.

शङ्कुक, अस्, m., N. of a poet (the author of
the Bhuvanābhyudaya); of a writer on rhetoric.
शङ्कुचि, इस्, m. a skate fish.

शाङ्कुची शाङ्कुची, f. the skate fish (= शङ्-
कुची, शङ्कोच).

शङ्कुला, f. a kind of lancet or knife; a pair of
nippers or scissors (used to cut the betel-nut into
small pieces; cf. दन्त-शङ्कु).
—शङ्कुला-खण्ड,
अम्, n. a piece cut off with a pair of nippers.

सङ्कुल सङ्कुल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कुल् with
सम्; probably connected with सङ्-कर fr. सङ्-
कॄ), crowded together, thronged, mixed together,
commingled, confused, perplexed, disordered, incon-
sistent; filled with, full of; (अस्), m., N. of a poet;
(अम्), n. a crowd, throng, mob; a flock, collection;
a confused fight, battle, war, mêlée; inconsistent or
contradictory speech.
शङ्कोच, अस्, or शङ्कोचि, इस्, m. a skate fish.

सङ्-कोच, अस्, m. contracting, shriveling up, con-
traction, shrinking; terror, fear; compression, abridge-
ment, narrowness, diminution; shutting up, closing;
binding, tying; a sort of skate fish; (अम्), n. saffron.
—सङ्कोच-पिशुन, अम्, n. ‘manifesting contrac-
tion,’ saffron.

शङ्ख शङ्ख, अस्, अम्, m. n. (in Uṇādi-s. I.
104. said to be fr. rt. 1. शम्), a shell, the conch-
shell (used for offering libations or, when perforated
at one end, for blowing as a horn); a horn, trumpet,
(in the battle pieces of epic poetry each hero is
represented as provided with a conch-shell, which
serves as his horn, and often has a name; that of
Kṛṣṇa was called पाञ्चजन्य, q. v.); (अस्), m.
the temporal bone, temple; the bone of the forehead
or frontal bone; an elephant's cheek or the part
between his tusks (= हस्ति-दन्त-मध्य); a par-
ticular high number (said to equal a hundred bil-
lions or one hundred thousand Krores, = दश-नि-
खर्व; cf. शङ्कु); one of Kuvera's treasures; a
particular perfume (commonly called Nakhī and ap-
parently a kind of dried shell-fish); a military drum
or other martial instrument; N. of a Daitya (who
conquered the gods, stole the Vedas, and carried
them off to the bottom of the sea, from whence
they were recovered by Viṣṇu in the form of a
fish); N. of one of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or
serpents of Pātāla (described as of a yellow colour);
[]
N. of the author of a law-book; of a poet (one of
the nine gems at the court of king Vikramāditya);
of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 15 (having
the patronymic Yāmāyana); of one of the six minor
Dvīpas; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a Gotra; [cf. Gr. κόγχος,
κόγχη, κόλχος, κόχλος, κάλχη; Lat. concha.]
—शङ्-
ख-कर्णी, f. a kind of poison; [cf. महा-पञ्च-
विष.]
—शङ्ख-कार or शङ्ख-कारक, अस्, m.
a worker in shells, shell-cutter (described as a kind
of mixed caste; cf. शाङ्खिक).
—शङ्ख-कूट,
N. of a mountain.
—शङ्ख-क्षीर, अम्, n. ‘shell-
milk,’ any impossibility or absurdity.
—शङ्ख-
चक्र-गदा-धर, अस्, m. ‘holding a conch, a
discus, and a mace,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.
—शङ्ख-
चरी or शङ्ख-चर्ची, f. a mark made with sandal
on the forehead.
—शङ्ख-चूर्ण, अम्, n. ‘shell-
powder, powder produced from shells.
—शङ्ख-
ज, अस्, आ, अम्, shell-born, produced from shells;
(अस्), m. a large pearl shaped like a pigeon's egg.
—शङ्ख-द्राव or -द्रावक, अस्, m. a solvent for
dissolving the conch or other shells (used in medi-
cine).
—शङ्ख-द्राविन्, ई, m. ‘shell-fuser,’ a kind
of sorrel (= अम्ल-वेतस).
—शङ्ख-धर, अस्,
m., N. of an author; of a poet; (आ), f. a pot-herb
(= हिल-मोचिका).
—शङ्ख-ध्म, अस्, or शङ्-
ख-ध्मा, आस्, m. a shell-blower, horn-blower, one
who plays on the conch or horn.
—शङ्ख-ध्वनि,
इस्, m. the sound of a conch or horn.
—शङ्ख-
नख, अस्, m. a small shell, the shell of the Trochus
Perspectivus; the perfume called Nakhī (said to be a
kind of dried shell-fish, see नखी); another kind
of perfume, = वृहन्-नखी; (आ or ई), f. the per-
fume called Nakhī.
—शङ्ख-नाभ, अस्, m., N.
of a king.
—शङ्ख-पाद्, त्, or शङ्ख-पाद, अस्,
m., N. of a son of Kardama (said to have been made
regent of the south, Viṣṇu-Purāṇa I. 22).
—शङ्ख-
पाल, अस्, m. ‘shell-nourisher,’ epithet of the sun;
N. of a Nāga or serpent of Pātāla.
—शङ्ख-पुष्-
पी, f. a sort of plant (= कम्बु-पुष्पी).
—शङ्ख-
प्रणाद, अस्, m. the sound of a conch or horn.
—शङ्ख-प्रवर, अस्, अम्, m. n. an excellent
shell, the best shell.
—शङ्ख-प्रस्थ, अस्, m. a
mark or spot on the moon.
—शङ्ख-भिन्न, अस्,
ई, अम्, see Vopa-deva IV. 20.
—शङ्ख-भृत्, त्, त्, त्,
carrying or bearing a conch-shell; (त्), m. an epithet
of Viṣṇu.
—शङ्ख-मुक्ता, f. mother of pearl;
(आस्), f. pl. shells and pearls.
—शङ्ख-मुख, अस्,
m. ‘shell-faced,’ an alligator.
—शङ्ख-मूल, अम्,
n. a particular esculent root (= मूलक).
—शङ्ख-
राज्, ट्, m. the best of shells.
—शङ्ख-रावित, अम्,
n. a sound of conches.
—शङ्ख-लिखित, औ, m. du.
the two Ṛṣis, Śaṅkha and Likhita (authors of a
law-book); (अस्), m. a king who practises justice,
a just king; शङ्खलिखिता वृत्तिः, conduct re-
sembling that of Śaṅkha and Likhita.
—शङ्ख-
लिखित-प्रिय, अस्, m. beloved by Śaṅkha and
Likhita, a friend of strict justice.
—शङ्ख-स्मृति,
इस्, f. the law-book of Śaṅkha.
—शङ्ख-स्वन, अस्,
m. the sound of a conch or trumpet.
—शङ्खाख्य
(˚ख-आख्˚), अस्, m. a kind of perfume (= वृहन्-
नखी).
—शङ्खान्तर-द्योतिन् (˚ख-अन्˚), ई,
इनी, इ, shining in the middle of the frontal bone.
—शङ्खासुर (˚ख-अस्˚), अस्, m. the Daitya
Śaṅkha.
—शङ्खाह्वा (˚ख-आह्˚), f. a sort of
plant (= शङ्ख-पुष्पी).
—शङ्खोदक (˚ख-
उद्˚), अम्, n. the water poured into a conch-shell.

शाङ्ख शाङ्ख, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शङ्ख), relat-
ing to the conch-shell, belonging to shells; (अम्),
n. the sound of a conch-shell.

शङ्खक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the conch-shell; (अस्),
m. a disease of the head (described as a pain in the
forehead and heat with a puffiness in the temples);
the temporal bone or temple; (अम्), n. a bracelet
(often made of conch-shell).

शङ्खिका, f. a kind of grass, Andropogon Acicu-
latum.

शाङ्खिक, अस्, ई, अम्, made from the Śaṅkha,
relating or belonging to the conch-shell or to any
shell, shelly; (अस्), m. a shell-cutter, worker or dealer
[]
in shells (constituting a particular caste called Śāṅ-
khāri); a player on the Śaṅkha, shell-blower (=
शङ्ख-ध्मा).

शङ्खिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing shells, having or
holding a conch-shell; (ई), m. the ocean; a worker
in shells; a shell-blower; an epithet of Viṣṇu;
(इनी), f., N. of various plants, a sort of grass, Andro-
pogon Aciculatum; a particular plant, Cissampelos
Hexandra; another plant (= यव-तिक्ता); N. of one
of the four classes into which females are divided
(described as tall and handsome, with long eyes and
[]
hair, marked with three lines on the neck, amorous
and irascible, and neither stout nor thin); a particular
goddess or Śakti worshipped by Buddhists; a female
spirit, a kind of semi-divine being or fairy (= उप-
देवता-विशेष).
—शङ्खिनी-फल, अस्, m. the
Śirīṣa tree.
—शङ्खिनी-फल, अस्, m. the
Śirīṣa tree.
—शङ्खिनी-वास, अस्, m. a small tree,
Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट).

शाङ्करि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Kārttikeya; of
Gaṇeśa; fire; N. of a Muni.

शाङ्खमित्रि, इस्, m., N. of a Vedic grammarian,
(also written शाङ्खमित्र.)

शाङ्खायन, अस्, m., N. of the author of the
Śāṅkhāyana-Brāhmaṇa and of certain Śrauta-sūtras.
—शाङ्खायन-चरण, N. of a Caraṇa of the Ṛg-
veda.
—शाङ्खायन-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n., N. of a
Brāhmaṇa (belonging to the Ṛg-veda; see ब्राह्-
मण.)
—शाङ्खायन-सूत्र, अम्, n. the Śrauta-
sūtras attributed to Śāṅkhāyana.

शाङ्खायनिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the pupils of Śāṅ-
khāyana.

शाङ्गुष्ठा शाङ्गुष्ठा, f. the shrub Abrus
Precatorius (= गुञ्जा).

शाङ्गोष्ठा, f. another reading for शार्ङ्गष्ठा,
q. v.

सङ्-घ, अस्, m. close contact or combination;
any collection or assemblage, heap, multitude, quantity,
crowd, host, band, number, group, flock, shoal; any
[]
number of people or inhabitants living together.
—सङ्घ-गुप्त, अस्, m. a proper N., (also read
सिंह-गुप्त.)
—सङ्घ-चारिन्, ई, m. ‘going in
shoals,’ a fish.
—सङ्घ-जीविन्, ई, m. ‘living by
multitudes of people,’ a hired labourer, porter, cooly.
—सङ्घ-तल, अस्, m. the two hands joined with
the open palms brought together.
—सङ्घ-पुष्पी,
f. a particular plant (= धातकी).
—सङ्घ-वृत्ति,
इस्, f. a state of close combination.
—सङ्घवृत्ति-
ता, f. combined action.
—सङ्घ-शस्, ind. collec-
tively, all together; by troops, in flocks, in shoals,
in companies.
सङ्घ सङ्-घ. See under सं-हन्.

सङ्-घात, अस्, m. close combination, union,
association, connection, confederacy; a collection,
quantity, assemblage, multitude, heap, cluster, band;
a collection of mucus, phlegm [cf. सङ्-घाणक];
composition of words, formation of compounds;
striking, killing, hurting; a particular gait or mode
of walking (in the drama); N. of a division of the
infernal regions; [cf. सं-हात.]
—सङ्घात-क-
ठिन, अस्, आ, अम्, compactly or solidly hard, hard
from solidity or compactness.
—सङ्घात-पत्त्रिका,
f. a sort of fennel (= शत-पुष्पा).
—सङ्घात-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having close union, possessing a heap
or multitude, closely compacted or combined.
सङ्घात सङ्-घात. See under सं-हन्.

सङ्कट सङ्-कट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सम् + कट,
q. v.), ‘having the hips close together,’ contracted,
narrow, strait; impassable, impervious; crowded;
(अस्), m. a proper N.; (आ), f. a particular goddess
worshipped at Benares; a particular Yoginī, (seven
others are named, viz. Maṅgalā, Piṅgalā, Dhanyā,
Bhrāmarī, Bhadrikā, Ulkā, Siddhi); (अम्), n. a
narrow passage, strait, defile, pass; a strait, difficulty,
trouble, (प्राण-सङ्कट, risk of life.)
—सङ्क-
टाक्ष (˚ट-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘having contracted
eyes,’ winking, leering; (अस्), m. the tree Grislea
Tomentosa (= धव).
—सङ्कटापन्न (˚ट-
आप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, beset with difficulties.

सङ्कथ् सङ्-कथ् (सम्-कथ्), cl. 10. P. -क-
थयति, -यितुम्, to relate or narrate fully, tell, com-
municate, inform; to explain; to speak about or of
(with acc.); to converse.

सङ्-कथन, अम्, n. the act of narrating fully,
narration, relation.

सङ्-कथा, f. conversation, discourse, talking to-
gether.

सङ्-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, related, narrated, com-
municated.
सङ्-कथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being told or related.

सङ्कन् सङ्-कन् (सम्-कन्, cf. 2. का, rt. कै),
cl. 1. P. -कनति, &c. (apparently only used in the
participle below), Ved. to be satisfied or pleased, &c.;
[cf. rt. चक्.]

सङ्कम्प् सङ्-कम्प् (सम्-कम्प्), cl. 1. A.
-कम्पते, -कम्पितुम्, to shake about, quake,
tremble: Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
shake or tremble.

सङ्कर्षण सङ्-कर्षण. See under सङ्-
कृष्.

सङ्-कर्षण, अम्, n. the act of drawing together,
contracting; shortening; attracting, drawing; mak-
ing rows, ploughing, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of the first-
born offspring of Viṣṇu, (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 7527);
epithet of Bala-deva or Bala-rāma (elder brother of
Kṛṣṇa, and so called because withdrawn from the
womb of Devakī and transferred to that of Rohiṇī);
a proper N.
—सङ्कर्षण-काण्ड, N. of a work
ascribed to Jaimini.
—सङ्कर्षणेश्वर-तीर्थ
(˚ण-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

सङ्कल् 1. सङ्-कल् (सम्-कल्, see rt. 2. कल्),
cl. 10. P. -कालयति, -यितुम्, to drive together, drive
to; to drive away, put to flight.

सङ्कल् 2. सङ्-कल् (सम्-कल्, see rt. 3. कल्),
cl. 10. P. -कलयति, -यितुम्, to heap together, pile
up, accumulate; to grasp, lay hold of; to consider,
deem, regard as.
सङ्-कला, ind. (doubtful), killing, slaughter.

सङ्-कल, अस्, m. collection, accumulation, quan-
tity; addition.

साङ्कल साङ्कल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सङ्-कल),
effected or produced by addition, accumulated, &c.

सङ्-कलन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of heaping toge-
ther; contact, junction, collision, intermixture; blend-
ing, twining; (अम्), n. addition (in arithmetic).

सङ्-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped together, piled up,
collected, brought together, blended, intermixed,
arranged; added; laid hold of, grasped; (आ), f. (in
arithmetical progression) the first sum; (अम्), n.
addition (in arithmetic).
—सङ्-कलितैक्य (˚ता-
ऐक्˚), अम्, n. the sum of the sums or terms (of an
arithmetical progression).

सङ्कल्प सङ्-कल्प, &c. See under सङ्-
कॢप्.

सङ्-कल्प, अस्, m. will, volition, strength of will,
purpose, mental resolve or determination, resolution,
vow; power of will; wish, desire; idea formed in
the mind, thought, imagination, fancy, contrivance;
consideration, reflection; mind, soul, heart; idea or
expectation of advantage from any voluntary act;
a solemn vow to perform a ritual observance, decla-
ration of purpose; a declaration repeated by a widow
who burns herself with her deceased husband; N. of
a Prajā-pati; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and
wife of Dharma.
—सङ्कल्प-कुल्मल, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. having desire for its shaft (said of an arrow).
—सङ्कल्प-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from self-
determined will or desire, proceeding from idea of
advantage; (अस्), m. ‘mind-born, heart-born,’ epi-
thet of Kāma (god of love).
—सङ्कल्प-जन्मन्,
आ, or सङ्कल्प-भव, अस्, or सङ्कल्प-योनि, इस्,
m. epithet of Kāma (god of love).
—सङ्कल्प-
रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, formed or consisting of will, of
the nature of mental resolve, conformable to the will
or purpose.
—सङ्कल्प-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्,
produced from will or desire, arising out of an idea
or desire of advantage; (अस्), m. ‘mind-born,’ epi-
thet of Kāma.
—सङ्कल्प-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
perfected by mental resolve or will, having super-
natural powers by the exercise of a strong will.
—सङ्कल्पात्मक (˚प-आत्˚), अस्, इका, अम्, con-
sisting of will or volition, of the nature of mental
resolve; willing, resolving.

सङ्कसुक सङ्-कसुक, अस्, आ, अम् (according
to Uṇādi-s. II. 29. fr. rt. कस् with सम्), going or
moving about unsteadily, unsteady, inconstant, fickle,
changeable; uncertain, doubtful; weak, feeble; bad,
wicked; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymn
Ṛg-veda X. 18 (having the patronymic Yāmāyana).

सङ्काश् सङ्-काश् (सम्-काश्), cl. 1. A. -काशते,
काशितुम्, to appear together, appear in sight, become
visible: Caus. -काशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to ap-
pear; to look at, see, contemplate, behold.

सङ्-काश, अस्, m. appearance; presence; vicinity,
(गृह-सङ्काशे, in the neighbourhood of the house,
near the house); (अस्, आ, अम्), like, similar (at the
end of comps., e. g. मृत्यु-सङ्काश, death-like;
गज-स्˚, resembling elephants); near, close at hand.
सङ्-काश्य, N. of a kingdom.

साङ्काश्य साङ्काश्य, N. of the country of
king Kuśa-dhvaja (brother of Janaka); (आ), f., N.
of Kuśa-dhvaja's capital, (Rāmāyaṇa 1. 70, 3.)
—साङ्काश्य-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of Sāṅkāśya,’
epithet of Kuśa-dhvaja, (see सीता.)

सङ्किल सङ्किल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
किल् with सम्), a burning torch, fire-brand.
सङ्कीर्ण सङ्-कीर्ण. See under सङ्-कॄ.

सङ्-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, poured together, mixed
together, intermingled, confused, miscellaneous,
crowded, closely packed; indistinct; scattered, strewed,
spread, diffused; sprinkled (with exuding juice, as a
rutting elephant); of mixed caste, of impure origin,
born from a mixed marriage, impure, polluted, adul-
terated; contracted, narrow; (अस्), m. a man of
mixed caste, an outcast; a mixed note or mode (in
music); an elephant possessing certain characteristic
marks or one in rut; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or
enigma.
—सङ्कीर्ण-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wandering
about confusedly, going to various places.
—सङ्-
कीर्ण-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, or सङ्कीर्ण-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ,
of mixed birth or caste, impure through illegal
intermarriage, of a mongrel breed, mule.
—सङ्-
कीर्ण-युद्ध, अम्, n. a mixed or confused fight,
mêlée.
सङ्कीर्तन सङ्-कीर्तन. See under सङ्-कॄत्.

सङ्-कीर्तन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of reciting or
proclaiming at full; greatly praising or celebrating,
extolling, lauding, honouring, glorification.

सङ्कुच् सङ्-कुच् (सम्-कुच्), cl. 6. 1. P. -कु-
चति, -कोचति, -कोचितुम्, to shrink, become con-
tracted, contract, shrivel up; to close, shut (as a flower);
to contract, compress: Pass. -कुच्यते, to be con-
tracted, be closed: Caus. -कोचयति, -यितुम्, to con-
tract, narrow, make smaller, lessen; to close up.

सङ्-कुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted, narrowed,
shriveled up, shrunk, wrinkled, (अ-सङ्कुचित, not
wrinkled); closed, shut, unblown (as a flower);
crouching, cowering.

सङ्-कोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, contracting, causing
to shrink or close, narrowing.

सङ्-कोचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shrinking, contracting, shrivel-
ing up; closing; astringent.

सङ्-कोच्य, ind. having contracted or compressed,
&c.

सङ्कुप् सङ्-कुप् (सम्-कुप्), cl. 4. P. A. -कुप्-
यति, -ते, -कोपितुम्, to become angry or enraged;
to be agitated or excited: Caus. -कोपयति, -यितुम्,
to make angry, enrage, provoke, excite; to become
agitated or excited.
सङ्-कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, aroused, excited.

सङ्-कोपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making angry, en-
raging, exciting.

सङ्कूज् सङ्-कूज् (सम्-कूज्), cl. 1. P. -कूजति,
&c., to cry aloud, utter inarticulate sounds.

सङ्-कूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, cried aloud; (अम्), n. the
cry of the Cakra-vāka.

सङ्कृ सङ्-कृ (सम्-कृ), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, = सं-स्-कृ, q. v.

सङ्कॄ सङ्-कॄ (सम्-कॄ), cl. 6. P. -किरति, -क-
रितुम्, -करीतुम्, to pour together, mix together,
commingle; to confuse; to scatter about, diffuse; to
pour out, bestow liberally or abundantly (Ved.); to
make full, fill: Pass. -कीर्यते, to be poured toge-
ther, be intermingled or mixed; to be confused.

सङ्-कृति, इस्, f. a kind of metre (consisting of four
lines of twenty-four syllables each); (इस्), m. a proper
N.; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a class of ancient Ṛṣis.

साङ्कृति साङ्कृति, इस्, m., N. of a sage (son
of Viśvā-mitra, and founder of the Vaiyāghrapadya
family).

सङ्कृत् सङ्-कृत् (सम्-कृत्), cl. 6. P. -कृन्-
तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut to pieces, cut up; to cut
through, cut, pierce.

सङ्कृत् सङ्-कृत् (सम्-कॄत्), cl. 10. P. -कीर्त-
यति, -यितुम्, to mention or relate fully, recite; to
proclaim, announce; to celebrate or praise or com-
mend greatly.

सङ्-कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut to pieces, cut through,
pierced.

सङ्-कृत्य, ind. having cut to pieces, having
cut up.

साङ्कृत्य, अस्, m., N. of a Muni; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a family or race.

सङ्कृष् सङ्-कृष् (सम्-कृष्), cl. 1. P. -कर्-
षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw together,
contract; to lace together, tighten; to draw away,
withdraw; to drag away with, drag along, carry off,
take away.

सङ्-कर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, drawing together,
contracting; drawing away.

सङ्-कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, drawing together, con-
tracting, shortening, (काल-सङ्कर्षिन्, shortening
the time; कालसङ्कर्षिणी विद्या, epithet of a
particular magical incantation.)

सङ्-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn together, con-
tracted (as two sounds), drawn near to one another.

सङ्करिन्, ई, इणी, इ, confusing, confused, inter-
mingled, produced by or resulting from illegal
mixture of castes.

सङ्-कीर्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, mentioning or de-
scribing fully, proclaiming; celebrating or praising
greatly.

सङ्-कीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned fully; cele-
brated, praised, renowned.

सङ्-कीर्त्ति, इस्, m., N. of a Vaiśya (said to have
been the author of certain Vedic hymns).

सङ्-कीर्त्य, ind. having mentioned, having cele-
brated, &c.

सङ्-कीर्त्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being proclaimed
or celebrated.

सङ्कॢप् सङ्-कॢप् (सम्-कॢप्), cl. 1. A. -कल्-
पते, -कल्पितुम्, -कल्प्तुम्, to will, wish for, long
for, be desirous of: Caus. -कल्पयति, -ते, -यितुम्,
to form or arrange or connect together; to create,
make, effect, furnish, provide; to will, purpose, re-
solve, determine, wish for, desire, intend, aim at,
strive after; to appoint, settle, fix, allot, assign, des-
tine; to consecrate, dedicate; to perform obsequies;
to form an idea in the mind, imagine, fancy; to
think about, weigh, ponder.

सङ्कल्पक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, purposing, deter-
mining, reflecting, pondering.

सङ्-कल्पनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be willed or wished
or desired; to be purposed or intended.

सङ्-कल्पयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing or striving
for; reflecting, considering, weighing.

सङ्-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished for, desired,
aimed at, striven after, intended, purposed, deter-
mined, resolved on; conceived, imagined, thought,
fancied, contrived.

सङ्-कल्प्य, ind. having resolved on, having
wished for or desired; having consecrated, having
performed funeral rites.

सङ्कॢप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, desired, wished; con-
trived.
सङ्कॢप्ति, इस्, f. will, resolve; fancy; contrivance.

सङ्केत सङ्-केत, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कित् = 4. चित्
with सम्), any indicatory sign or gesture, intimation,
hint, allusion, innuendo, sign, mark, token, symbol
(in general); gesticulation; a short explanatory rule
(teaching the application of grammatical Sūtras, =
शैली); agreement, convention; engagement, ap-
pointment, assignation (with a lover); condition,
provision.
—सङ्केत-निकेतन, अम्, n. a house or
place appointed for meeting (a lover &c.), place of
assignation, rendezvous.
—सङ्केत-पद्धति, इस्, f.,
N. of a work.
—सङ्केत-भूमि, इस्, f. a place of
assignation.
—सङ्केत-शिक्षा, f., N. of a work.
—सङ्केत-स्तव, अस्, m., N. of a hymn.
—सङ्-
केत-स्थान, अम्, n. place of assignation, appointed
place; a sign, intimation.

सङ्केतक, अस्, m. an agreement, convention,
appointment; a rendezvous.

सङ्केतन, अम्, n. the act of agreeing together,
appointment; a rendezvous.

सङ्केतय, Nom. P. सङ्केतयति, -यितुम्, to
[]
agree upon, appoint (a time &c.); to invite, call;
to counsel, advise.

साङ्ख्य साङ्ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. सङ्-ख्या),
relating to number or calculation, reckoning up, cal-

(ascribed to the sage Kapila, q. v., and so called as
‘reckoning up’ or ‘enumerating’ twenty-five Tat-
tvas or true principles, its object being to effect the
final liberation of the twenty-fifth Tattva [Puruṣa,
the Soul] from the fetters of the phenomenal crea-
tion by conveying the correct knowledge of the
twenty-four other Tattvas, and rightly discriminating
the Soul from them; these twenty-four principles
are divided into eight Prakṛtis or Producers and six-
teen Vikāras or Productions; the eight Producers
start from a Mūla-prakṛti or original Producer
[variously called Pradhāna, ‘chief one;’ A-vyakta,
‘unevolved;’ Brahman, ‘supreme;’ Māyā, ‘power
of illusion;’ Bahu-dhānaka, ‘much-containing’],
[]
which is emphatically the Prakṛti, ‘First-producer,’ or
‘Originant,’ being a kind of primordial germ whence
all the twenty-three remaining Tattvas are evolved;
its first production is the 2nd Tattva, viz. Buddhi,
Intellect [sometimes called महत् from its being
the great source of the two other internal organs
or instruments, Ahaṅkāra and Manas, which are
both modifications of it]; 3rd in order comes Ahaṅ-
kāra, ‘the I-making’ principle or sense of indi-
viduality; 4th come the five Tan-mātras or subtile
elementary particles out of which the five grosser
elements are evolved; the preceding eight principles
constitute the Producers, [all but the first being of
course in one sense also Productions]; then follow,
as proceeding from the Tan-mātras, the five Sthūla-
bhūtas or grosser elements [also called Mahā-bhūta],
viz. a. आकाश, space or ether, having the Guṇa or
property of sound [शब्द], which is the Viṣaya
or object of apprehension for the corresponding
Indriya or organ, the Ear; b. वायु, air, having the
Guṇa or property of tangibility or touch [स्पर्श],
which is the Viṣaya for the Skin; c. तेजस् or
ज्योतिस्, fire or light, having the property of form or
colour [रूप], which is the Viṣaya for the Eye;
d. आपस्, water, having the property of savour or
taste [रस], which is the Viṣaya for the Tongue;
e. पृथिवी or भूमि, earth, having the property of
odour or smell [गन्ध], which is the Viṣaya for
the Nose, [see गुण]; each of these elements after
the first having also the Guṇa or Guṇas of the pre-
ceding besides its own, and these Guṇas being some-
times identified with the Tan-mātras; then follow
the eleven organs, produced like the Tan-mātras from
the 3rd Tattva Ahaṅkāra, forming with them a
class of sixteen [षोडशकः]; these eleven organs
are the five above-named Buddhīndriyāṇi or organs
of sense, viz. ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose; the five
Karmendriyāṇi or organs of action, viz. larynx, hand,
foot, arms, and organ of generation; and an eleventh
organ called Manas, commonly translated ‘mind,’
which stands between both sets of Indriyas as an in-
ternal organ of perception and action, or of cogni-
tion and volition, [see मनस्]: the twenty-fifth
Tattva, Puruṣa or Soul, is to be wholly distinguished
from the twenty-four just enumerated; it is neither
a Producer nor Production; it is altogether passive,
and simply a looker-on, having nothing whatever to
do with the acts of creation, which it only contem-
plates, uniting itself with unintelligent Prakṛti, as
a lame man mounted on a blind man's shoulders,
for the sake of observing and enjoying the acts of
this Prakṛti, who herself cannot see or observe any-
thing; without that union no creation can take
place any more than can the birth of a child without
the union of male and female; this view of creation
implies the eternal existence of innumerable separate
individual souls, each soul by its junction with Pra-
kṛti causing the creation of its own phenomenal
world, which world, however, has an existence of
its own independent of all connection with the par-
ticular Puruṣa to which it is joined; moreover, each
soul is invested in the first place with a subtile body
[लिङ्ग-शरीर or सूक्ष्म-शरीर] composed of
Buddhi, Ahaṅkāra, the five Tan-mātras, and the
eleven organs, and afterwards with a grosser body
formed of the five elements; the former accompany-
ing the soul through all its transmigrations, while the
latter perishes; this system also teaches that Prakṛti
and its products may be regarded as made up of
three ingredients in a state of equipoise, viz. Sattva,
Rajas, and Tamas, Goodness, Passion, and Darkness,
commonly called Guṇas, but rather substances than
qualities, and more correctly translated ‘fetters,’ be-
cause they are like a triple-stranded rope [see
गुण] which binds and confines the soul: the Sāṅ-
khya system agrees with the Vedānta in being
synthetical, and so differing from the Analytical
Nyāya; its great point of divergence from the
Vedānta is in maintaining two principles which the
Vedānta denies, [see वेदान्त]; it is said to be
atheistical as ignoring all notice of a Supreme Soul,
[]
whose existence is, however, established by the Yoga
branch of the Sāṅkhya proper, [see योग]: the
vague outlines of the system before its crystallization
into a distinct school of dualism are propounded in
the first Book of Manu: its more fully developed
doctrines are contained in the Sāṅkhya-sūtras ascribed
to Kapila, in the Tattva-samāsa, or Summary of
Principles, ascribed to the same author, in the
Sāṅkhya-kārikā [see below], and the numerous
commentaries on these works, some of which are
enumerated below: the Buddhist system and that
of bishop Berkeley in Europe have many points of
connection with the Sāṅkhya, but the modern phi-
losophers of India pay far more attention to the
Nyāya and Vedānta); a follower of the Sāṅkhya
system of philosophy; a patronymic of the Vedic
Ṛṣi Atri; epithet of Śiva.

—साङ्ख्य-
भाष्य, अम्, n. = साङ्ख्य-प्रवचन-भाष्य.
—साङ्ख्य-भिक्षु, उस्, m. a particular kind of
mendicant.
—साङ्ख्य-मुख्य, अस्, m. epithet of
Śiva.
—साङ्ख्य-योग, अस्, m. ‘application of the
Sāṅkhya doctrine to the knowledge of spirit,’ N. of
the second chapter of the Bhagavad-gītā, (perhaps so
named as setting forth both the Sāṅkhya and Yoga
doctrines in regard to the soul; according to Śabda-
k. = ज्ञान-योग or ब्रह्म-विद्या.)
—साङ्ख्य-
योग-प्रवर्तिन्, ई, m. epithet of Śiva.
—साङ्ख्य-
वृत्ति-प्रकाश, अस्, m. = साङ्ख्य-तत्त्व-विलास.
—साङ्ख्य-वृत्ति-सार, अस्, m., N. of a commen-
tary on the Sāṅkhya-sūtra by Mahā-deva Sarasvatī.
—साङ्ख्य-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the Sāṅkhya doctrine
or system of philosophy; any treatise upon it.
—साङ्ख्य-सार or साङ्ख्य-सार-विवेक, अस्, m.,
N. of a work by Vijñāna-bhikṣu.
—साङ्ख्य-
सूत्र, अम्, N. of six books of aphorisms of the
Sāṅkhya philosophy ascribed to Kapila, (the number
of aphorisms is said to be 526.)
—साङ्ख्य-सूत्र-
विवरण, अम्, n., N. of a commentary on the Tat-
tva-samāsa.
—साङ्ख्यार्थ-तत्त्व-प्रदीपिका (˚य-
अर्˚), f., N. of a brief exposition of the Sāṅkhya
system by Bhaṭṭa-keśava.
—साङ्ख्यार्थ-सङ्ख्या-
यिक (˚य-अर्˚) = साङ्ख्य-तत्त्व-विलास.
—साङ्-
ख्यालङ्कार (˚य-अल्˚), अस्, m. = साङ्ख्य-क्रम-
दीपिका.

सङ्ख्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, numbering, amounting
to, composed of a certain number, (at the end of
comps., e. g. सहस्र-सङ्ख्यक, अस्, आ, अम्,
amounting to a thousand.)

सङ्-ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, reckoned up, enumerated,
calculated; numbered, counted; (आ), f. a kind of
riddle or enigma; (अम्), n. number.

सङ्-ख्यान, अम्, n. the act of reckoning up,
numbering, numeration, calculation.

सङ्-ख्याय, ind. having reckoned up, having
counted or numbered.

सङ्-ख्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reckoned or
counted up, numerable, calculable.

सङ्ग सङ्-ग, सङ्-गथ, &c. See below
and under rt. 1. सञ्ज्.

1. सङ्-ग, अस्, m. (for 2. सङ्ग see under rt.
1. सञ्ज्), coming together, concurrence, meeting,
encountering, conflict, war, battle, (in Naigh. II. 17.
सङ्गे is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामा-
नि); uniting, union, association, contact, touch, co-
herence; intercourse, keeping company, intimacy,
friendship, love; the confluence of rivers.
—१. सङ्ग-
विच्युति, इस्, f. dissolution of union, disunion.

2. सङ्ग, अस्, m. (for 1. सङ्-ग see under सङ्-
गम्), clinging to, adhering to, attachment, addiction
or devotion to, fondness, propensity for, worldly or
selfish attachment, affection, desire, wish, cupidity.
—सङ्ग-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from attachment,
indifferent, unworldly, stoical.
—सङ्ग-वर्जित, अस्,
आ, अम्, free from worldly attachments or affections,
unwordly.
—२. सङ्ग-विच्युति, इस्, f. separation from
wordly affection, dissolution of wordly attachments.

सङ्गा सङ्-गा (सम्-गा), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गा-
तुम्, to come together; to go to, approach.

साङ्ग साङ्ग (स-अङ्˚), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having
members or subdivisions; comprising every sub-
ordinate part, complete in every part, finished; to-
gether with the Aṅgas of the Veda, (see वेदाङ्ग.)

सङ्गणिका सङ्गणिका, f. (fr. rt. गण् with
सम्), incomparable or unequalled discourse (=
अप्रतिरूप-कथा).

सङ्गम् सङ्-गम् (सम्-गम्), cl. 1. A. -गच्-
छते (Pāṇ. I. 3, 29; but with an object P. -गच्छति;
in Hari-vaṃśa 14, 787. सम-गच्छतु occurs for
सङ्-गच्छतु, Perf. -जग्मे; Ved. forms &c.
-गमेमहि, -गमामहै, -अजग्मिरन्, -अगत,
-अगन्महि, -अगस्महि or -अगंस्महि, -ग्मि-
षीय, -गसीष्ट or -गंसीष्ट, -गंस्यते, &c.,
see rt. 1. गम्, cf. Pāṇ. I. 2, 13, VII. 2. 58), -गन्-
तुम्, to go together, come together, assemble, meet,
encounter (either in a friendly or hostile manner),
come into collision; to meet with, to ally or connect
one's self with; to have sexual intercourse with; to
meet harmoniously, harmonize, agree, be suitable or
fit, correspond; to become contracted, shrink up; to
go away, depart, die; to go to, attain (with acc.);
to go to, visit (P.): Caus. -गमयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to go together, bring together, connect or unite
with, endow or present with (with inst. of person and
acc. of thing); to connect, combine; to lead any one
to anything (with two acc.); to deliver or hand over
to another (with loc.), transfer, bestow, give.
सङ्-गत्, see Vopa-deva XXVI. 78.

सङ्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, convened,
met, encountered; joined, conjoined, united, associ-
ated; united in wedlock; sexually united; assembled,
collected, accumulated, mixed; fitted together, ap-
posite, proper, seasonable, appropriate, applicable,
adapted to, fitted for; in conjunction (as planets);
contracted, shrunk up; (अस्), m., N. of a king
(belonging to the Maurya dynasty); (अम्), n. com-
ing together, union, meeting; alliance, association,
intercourse, connection; friendship, acquaintance.
—सङ्गत-गात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having contracted
or shriveled limbs.
—सङ्गत-सन्धि, इस्, m. a
peace concluded after friendship.

सङ्-गति, इस्, f. coming together, meeting, inter-
view, union, junction, conjunction, mixture; associa-
tion, intercourse, society; sexual intercourse; adapta-
tion, fitness, appropriateness, applicability; going to,
visiting, frequenting; meeting or coming to pass
accidentally, chance, accident, (सङ्गत्या, by chance,
haply); going to, visiting, frequenting; becoming
acquainted, knowledge, questioning for further in-
formation.
सङ्-गत्य, ind. = सङ्-गम्य, col. 3.

सङ्-गत्वा (anom. ind. part.), having come toge-
ther, having met, &c.

सङ्-गथ, Ved. coming together, encountering,
conflict, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the
सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); flowing together, confluence,
(Sāy. = सङ्-गमन); (आ), f. confluence.

सङ्-गम, अस्, m. coming together, meeting, en-
counter, conflict, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated
among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); union, congress,
junction, conjunction, contact, touch; association,
society, company; sexual intercourse; flowing toge-
ther, confluence (of rivers); fitness, adaptation; mix-
ture; meeting with, acquiring, &c.; (in astronomy)
planetary conjunction.
—सङ्गमेश्वर (˚म-ईश्˚),
अस्, m., N. of Viśva-nātha; (अम्), n., N. of a
Liṅga.

साङ्गम साङ्गम, अस्, m. (fr. सङ्-गम),
coming together, union, meeting, encounter.

सङ्-गमन, अम्, n. the act of coming together,
meeting; going with; intercourse, union; (अस्, ई,
अम्), uniting, bestowing; any person or thing form-
ing a point of union; (अस्), m., N. of Yama.
साङ्गमन, अस्, m. See under अन्-अश्नत्.

सङ्गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be met or brought
together, relating to union or congress, causing re-
union.

सङ्-गमय्य, ind. having united, having joined,
having delivered over.

सङ्-गमित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, con-
nected, united, delivered over.
—सङ्गमित-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, one who has brought together or united.

सङ्-गम्य, ind. having met, having come toge-
ther, having become united, having had sexual inter-
course with.

1. सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going with or to, uniting
with, meeting.

2. सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see under सङ्-गम्),
full of attachment or devotion, attached, devoted,
addicted to, fond of, intent on, connected with; full
of affection or desire, desirous; libidinous, lustful;
continuous, uninterrupted, (Kirāt. XIV. 59.)
सङ्गमनेर सङ्गमनेर, N. of a place.

सङ्गर सङ्-गर. See under 1. and 2. सङ्-
गॄ, p. 1048, col. 1.

सङ्गर्ज् सङ्-गर्ज् (सम्-गर्ज्), cl. 1. P. -गर्-
जति, -गर्जितुम्, to roar together, roar at, shout out
against, cry out defiantly.

सङ्गव सङ्-गव, Ved. the time when cows
are collected for milking, i. e. early morning or at the
end of night, (Sāy. सङ्गवे = रात्र्य्-अपरकाले, see
Ṛg-veda V. 76, 3, where सङ्गव is enumerated
among the five divisions of the day; according to
some, it is the second of these divisions coming
three Muhūrtas after Prātastana or the first dawn,
cf. प्रातस्तन; the other three are मध्याह्न,
पराह्ण, and सायाह्न.)
—सङ्गव-काल, अस्, m.
the time when cows are brought together for milking.

सङ्गाद सङ्-गाद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. गद् with
सम्), conversation.

सङ्गाह् सङ्-गाह् (सम्-गाह्), cl. 1. A. -गाहते,
गाहितुम्, -गाढुम्, to plunge into, enter, go into.
सङ्गिर् सङ्-गिर्. See under 1. सङ्-गॄ.
सङ्-गिर्, ईर्, f., Ved. a song of praise, hymn.
सङ्गीत सङ्-गीत, &c. See under सङ्-गै.

सङ्-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung together, sung in
chorus or harmony; (अम्), n. a song sung by many
voices, chorus; singing accompanied by music and
dancing, symphony; a concert; the art of singing
with music and dancing.
—सङ्गीत-कौमुदी, f.,
N. of a work on harmony.
—सङ्गीत-गीति, इस्, इस्, इ,
one who sings a song, a singer.
—सङ्गीत-दर्पण,
‘mirror of harmony,’ N. of a work on music by
Dāmodara.
—सङ्गीत-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a
work on symphony by Nārāyaṇa.
—सङ्गीत-रत्न-
माला, f., N. of a work on harmony by Mammaṭa.
—सङ्गीत-रत्नाकर (˚न-आक्˚), अस्, m. ‘jewel-
mine of singing,’ N. of a musical work by Śārṅga-
deva.
—सङ्गीतरत्नाकर-कला-निधि, इस्, m., N.
of a commentary on the Saṅgīta-ratnākara.
—सङ्-
गीत-व्यापृत, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in singing and
music.
—सङ्गीत-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the science of singing
combined with music and dancing; any work on the
above subject.
—सङ्गीत-सार and सङ्गीतार्णव
(˚त-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of two works.
—सङ्गीतार्थ
(˚त-अर्˚), अस्, m. the apparatus or materials for a
concert; the subject of a musical performance.
—सङ्-
गीतावसान (˚त-अव्˚), अम्, n. the close of a concert.

सङ्गुप् सङ्-गुप् (सम्-गुप्). See rt. 2. गुप्,
p. 292.

सङ्-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well guarded or protected,
preserved; well hidden, concealed, covered over, kept
secret; (अस्), m. a particular Buddha or Buddhist
saint.
—सङ्गुप्तार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, m. a secret
matter, hidden meaning; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a
secret or hidden meaning.

सङ्-गोपन, अम्, n. the act of hiding or conceal-
ing well, complete concealment.
सङ्गोपन सङ्-गोपन. See under सङ्-गुप्.

सङ्-गोपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be completely
hidden or concealed.

सङ्गुह् सङ्-गुह् (सम्-गुह्), cl. 1. P. A. -गू-
हति, -ते, &c. (see rt. 1. गुह्), to cover or conceal
completely.

सङ्-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, completely concealed or
hidden from view; contracted, abridged; brought
into contact, united, joined, heaped together, piled,
arranged.

सङ्गृभित सङ्-गृभित, सङ्-गृहीत, &c.
See under सङ्-ग्रह्.

सङ्-गृभित, अस्, आ, अम्, grasped, griped, con-
centrated.

सङ्गॄ^1 1. सङ्-गॄ (सम्-गॄ, see rt. 1. गॄ), cl.
9. P. A., 6. A. -गृणाति, -गृणीते, -गिरते, &c., to
speak about or praise together; to agree together,
agree with (with inst.), assent, promise; to recognise,
acknowledge; to agree in calling or naming (A.).

सङ्गृ 2. सङ्-गॄ, (सम्-गॄ, see rt. 2. गॄ), cl.
6. 9. P. -गिरति, -गृणाति, &c., to swallow up, de-
vour.

सङ्-गिरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeing, assenting
to; promising.

सङ्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, agreed, assented to, pro-
mised.
सङ्-गीर्य, ind. having swallowed up or devoured.

सङ्गै सङ्-गै (सम्-गै), cl. 1. P. -गायति,
गातुम्, to sing together, sing in chorus, chant; to
celebrate by singing together.

सङ्गीतक, अम्, n. a concert, symphony, public
entertainment consisting of songs combined with
dancing and music.

सङ्-गीति, इस्, f. singing together, a concert, sym-
phony, harmony, the art of singing combined with
music and dancing; conversation, discourse; a species
of metre.

सङ्-गीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being sung together,
being chanted.

सङ्ग्रथ् सङ्-ग्रथ् (सम्-ग्रथ्). See rt.
1. ग्रथ्.

सङ्-ग्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strung or tied
together, knotted together.

सङ्ग्रस् सङ्-ग्रस् (सम्-ग्रस्), cl. 1. P. A.
-ग्रसति, -ते, -ग्रसितुम्, to swallow up, devour,
consume: Pass. -ग्रस्यते, &c., to be devoured,
consumed, &c.

सङ्ग्रह् सङ्-ग्रह् or सङ्-ग्रभ् (सम्-ग्˚, see
rt. ग्रह्, p. 302), cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते
(Ved. generally -गृभ्णाति, -गृभ्णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्,
to seize or hold together, grasp, gripe, clench, take
or lay hold of, snatch; to apprehend, conceive, un-
derstand; to take, receive, accept, receive kindly or
hospitably, attend to, listen to, encourage, support,
favour, protect; to carry off; to seize on, attack (as
[]
an illness); to gather together, assemble, collect,
compile; to include, comprehend, contain; to draw
together, contract, make narrow or smaller, abridge;
to draw together a bow (in order to unstring it); to
hold in, restrain, check, govern; to keep together,
close, shut (as the mouth); to concentrate (the
mind); to constrain, force; to take in marriage,
marry; to mention, name: Caus. -ग्राहयति, -यि-
तुम्, to cause to take hold of or receive, cause any
one to accept (with two acc.): Desid. -जिघृक्षति,
to wish to take hold of, &c., to desire to collect; to
wish to take in marriage, desire to marry.

सङ्-गृभ्या, ind., Ved. (for सङ्-गृभ्य) =
सङ्-गृह्य below.
सङ्-गृह्णत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seizing, laying hold of.

सङ्-गृह्य, ind. having seized, having carried off,
having restrained; having constrained.

सङ्-ग्रह, अस्, m. seizing, grasping, clench-
ing (the fist), grasp, grip, taking hold of, taking;
reception, admission, assent; guarding, protecting,
protection, favouring, supporting, encouraging, pro-
pitiating, receiving kindly, entertaining, entertain-
ment; bringing together, conjunction, collection,
conglomeration, compilation; agglomeration (a par-
ticular kind of संयोग or conjunction in phil.);
comprehension; sum, amount, totality; abridge-
ment, epitome, summary; a catalogue, list; restrain-
ing, confining, controlling, governing; effort, exertion;
a store-room, place where anything is kept; mention,
mentioning; greatness, elevation, loftiness; velocity;
epithet of Śiva; N. of several works; [cf. धनञ्-
जय-स्˚, स्मृति-स्˚.]
—सङ्ग्रह-कार, अस्, m. the
composer or author of the Saṅgraha.
—सङ्ग्रह-
श्लोक, अस्, m. a verse recapitulating what has been
explained before (in prose intermixed with Sūtras).
सङ्ग्रह, N. of a grammatical work by Vyāḍi.

सङ्-ग्राह, अस्, m. forcible seizure or grasp, laying
hold of; clenching the fist; the fist; the handle of
a shield.

सङ्-ग्रहण, अम्, n. the act of taking hold of,
seizing, grasping, accepting, receiving, admitting,
supporting, encouraging, hoping; embracing car-
nally, intercourse with a female, (see स्त्री-स्˚);
adultery; bringing or gathering together, compiling,
collecting, mixing, blending; inlaying, enchasing;
(ई), f. diarrhœa, dysentery.

सङ्-ग्रहीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who restrains, &c.;
(ता), m. a driver, charioteer.

सङ्-ग्राहक, अस्, m. a gatherer, collector, com-
piler.

सङ्-ग्राहित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be taken hold
of or received, imparted, bestowed.

सङ्-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seizing, grasping, holding;
collecting, contracting, &c.; (ई), m. the Kuṭa-ja tree.

सङ्-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laid hold of or
seized; to be collected; to be received.

सङ्ग्राम् सङ्ग्राम् (rather to be regarded
as a Nom. fr. सङ्ग्राम below), cl.
10. A. सङ्ग्रामयते (also P. -ति), -यितुम्, Aor.
अससङ्ग्रामत, to make war, fight.

सङ्ग्राम, अस्, m. war, battle, fighting; a proper
N.
—सङ्ग्राम-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering in battle;
(त्), m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa.
—सङ्ग्राम-प-
टह, अस्, m. a large military drum.

सङ्घट् सङ्-घट् (सम्-घट्), cl. 1. A. -घ-
टते, -घटितुम्, to assemble together, meet: Caus.
-घटयति, -घाटयति, -यितुम्, to cause to assem-
ble, collect; to join together, fasten together; to strike
[]
(a musical instrument), sound [cf. सङ्-घट्ट्]: In-
tens. -जाघटीति, to be well fitted or adapted for
anything.

सङ्घट्ट् सङ्-घट्ट् (सम्-घट्ट्), cl. 1. A.
-घट्टते, -घट्टितुम्, to rub together, crush to
pieces, bruise: Caus. -घट्टयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to rub against (with inst.); to strike against, touch;
to bring together, collect, assemble.

सङ्-घटित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, assembled;
struck, sounded.

सङ्-घट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, struck against, touched;
assembled, collected.

सङ्-घट्य, ind. having joined or united toge-
ther, having assembled.
सङ्घाटी, f. in भिक्षु-सङ्घाटी, q. v.

सङ्-घट्ट, अस्, m. rubbing together, friction;
clashing together, collision, shock, clash, encounter,
conflict; meeting, joining together, cohesion, rivalry,
(अ-सङ्घट्ट-सुखम्, without any rival to one's
happiness, Raghu-v. XIV. 86); embracing; (आ), f. a
large creeper (= लता).
—सङ्घट्ट-चक्र, अम्, n.
a particular astrological diagram intended as a guide
for determining the proper season for war.

सङ्-घट्टन, अम्, आ, n. f. rubbing together,
friction; collision; close contact, cleaving or adhering
to; the intertwining of wrestlers; the embrace of
lovers; contact, cohesion, union, junction; collecting,
meeting, encountering, occurrence.

सङ्-घट्टयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to rub
against, rubbing together.

सङ्-घट्टय्य, ind. having brought together,
having collected.

सङ्घाणक सङ्घाणक, अस्, अम्, m. n. = सिं-
हाणक, the mucus of the nose; [cf. सङ्-घात.]
सङ्घात्य, a kind of dramatic performance.

सङ्घुष् सङ्-घुष् (सम्-घुष्), cl. 1. P.
-घोषति, -घोषितुम्, to sound together, resound,
sound; to proclaim aloud, cry (in offering for sale);
to fill with cries, make resonant.

सङ्-घुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, proclaimed
aloud; resonant, resounding.

सङ्घृष् सङ्-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति,
-घर्षितुम्, to rub together, grind together, tritu-
rate; to rub against another (with सह and inst.),
contend with, vie with: Pass. -घृष्यते (ep. also
P. -ति), to rub against each other (sometimes with
परस्परम्), come into collision, contend for
superiority, vie with each other.

सङ्-घर्ष, अस्, m. rubbing together, grinding,
trituration, friction; collision, mutual attrition, rivalry,
emulation, vying or contending for superiority (=
परस्पर-स्पर्धा); envy; going gently, gliding,
flowing (= सं-सर्प).

सङ्-घर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, rubbing together, vying
with one another, emulating.

सङ्-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed with, rubbed
together.

सङ्-घृष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, rubbing together,
coming into collision.

सङ्घ्रा सङ्-घ्रा (सम्-घ्रा), cl. 1. P. A.
Ved. -जिघ्रति, -ते, -घ्रातुम्, Ved. to smell at one
another (as animals), be on intimate or familiar
terms, be closely connected: Caus. -घ्रापयति,
-यितुम्, to bring into close connection or intimacy,
make intimate.

साङ्कर्य साङ्कर्य, अम्, n. (fr. सङ्-कर),
mixing or blending together confusedly, confusion,
mixture.
—साङ्कर्य-वाद, अस्, m., N. of a short
Nyāya treatise.

साङ्केतिक साङ्केतिक (fr. सङ्केत), अस्, ई, अम्,
conventional; indicatory, symbolical, expressed by
signs or tokens or marks, consisting of signs, &c.

साङ्क्षेपिक साङ्क्षेपिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सङ्-
क्षेप), throwing together, abridging; abridged,
contracted, concise, summary, short.

साङ्ख्यायन, अस्, m. (probably for शाङ्ख्या-
यन), N. of a Muni; of the author of certain
Gṛhya-sūtras, &c.
—साङ्ख्यायन-सूत्र, अम्, n.
the Sūtras of Sāṅkhyāyana.

साङ्गोपाङ्ग (˚ग-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, along with the
Aṅgas and Upāṅgas, (see वेदाङ्ग, उपाङ्ग.)

साङ्गज साङ्गज (स-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, toge-
ther with hair, covered with hair.

साङ्गतिक साङ्गतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सङ्-
गति), relating or belonging to union or association,
relating to society, social, associating; (अस्), m. a
visitor, guest, new comer; one who comes to transact
business.

साङ्गारक साङ्गारक (स-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
attended by the planet Mars.

साङ्गुष्ठम् साङ्गुष्ठम् (स-अङ्˚), ind. toge-
ther with the thumb.

साङ्ग्रामिक साङ्ग्रामिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सङ्ग्रा-
म), relating to war; warlike, martial; (अस्), m. a
commander, general.

साङ्घातिक साङ्घातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सङ्-
घात), utterly destructive, causing complete destruc-
tion, very deadly, killing.

साङ्मुखी साङ्मुखी, f. (according to Śab-
da-k.), N. of a particular Tithi, q. v.
